stem: Which sentence best demonstrates that the author and his father depended on the people of the reservation?

options.label: A
options.text: It is a beautiful language, intricate and full of subtlety, and very difficult to learn.

options.label: B
options.text: When we ventured out into those areas, we saw a lot of people, but they were always off by themselves, it seemed, living a life of their own, each one having an individual existence in that huge landscape.

options.label: C
options.text: She made a wonderful subject, and I have always thought very well of the photograph that my father made of her.

options.label: D
options.text: Yes, the road is very muddy, the old man would answer, laughing, and we knew then that we were at his mercy, held fast in the groove of his humor and goodwill.
